title: It’s Time to Come Home
speaker: Jennie Allen
notes: Revival begins with repentance. In Luke 15, Jesus tells the story of two sons who are both far from the heart of their father. One runs to a distant country while the other stays home but is blinded by his own pride. Yet the invitation for both is the same: come home. In this message, Jennie Allen challenges us to throw off the sin and weight holding us back, bring what has been hidden into the light and believe the truth of the gospel: there is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. speaker: Joby Martin
notes: What does the Bible really say about the end times, and how should we live knowing Jesus is coming back? Don’t get so caught up in predicting when Jesus will return that you miss the point. The question isn’t whether you have every detail figured out. The question is whether you know Him, love Him and have personally surrendered your life to the lordship of Jesus Christ. title: How To Be Great
speaker: Joby Martin
notes: What does it really mean to be great in the Kingdom of God? In Matthew 20, Jesus completely redefines greatness. While the world measures success by position, possessions and power, Jesus shows us a different way. True greatness begins by bending our knee to Him, enduring pain with perseverance, living under godly authority and humbling ourselves to serve others. This message challenges us to examine what is truly first in our lives and reminds us that proximity to Jesus, not what we produce, determines Kingdom success. Following Jesus does not promise a life of comfort, but He faithfully walks with us through the pain and uses it to shape us. Jesus Himself is our ultimate example. He did not come to be served, but to serve and give His life as a ransom for many. In His Kingdom, greatness is not found by climbing over others to reach the top. speaker: Joby Martin
notes: What if the greatest obstacle to experiencing God's grace isn't your past, but your sense of entitlement? In Matthew 20, Jesus tells the Parable of the Workers in the Vineyard, revealing a powerful truth about the Kingdom of God. Salvation is never something we earn through our efforts. It is a gift freely given because of the generosity of our Heavenly Father. Whether you've followed Jesus for decades or surrendered your life to Him today, every believer stands on the same foundation of grace. In this message, Pastor Joby Martin challenges us to trade comparison for gratitude, entitlement for humility, and self-focus for worship. title: Kid Pain
notes: What do you do when faith feels impossible? In Matthew 17, Jesus reveals His glory on the mountain before stepping into a valley filled with fear, suffering and doubt. Through the Transfiguration and the healing of a demon possessed boy, we are reminded that Jesus is greater than our circumstances and worthy of our trust. Faith isn't pretending to have all the answers or never struggling with doubt. It's bringing our honest hearts to Jesus and trusting Him even when life doesn't make sense. When we fix our eyes on Christ instead of our circumstances, we discover that what seems impossible for us is never impossible for Him.

speaker: Joby Martin
notes: What happens when evil and good seem to grow side by side in the world?
